أجتن (form VIII)
# أَجْتَنِ (ʔajtani) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.ni/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
# أُجْتَنَ (ʔujtana) /ʔud͡ʒ.ta.na/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
